prompt: HTML date-time microsyntax T Z letter case constraint
answer:
In the HTML date-time microsyntax:

- The separator must be an uppercase `T` (`U+0054`) or, for a non-normalized local/global date-time string, a single space.
- The UTC designator must be an uppercase `Z` (`U+005A`).
- Lowercase `t` and `z` are not valid.
- A normalized local date-time string requires uppercase `T`.

Sources: [HTML Standard](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/common-microsyntaxes.html), [W3C HTML5 data types](https://w3c.github.io/html-reference/datatypes.html).
